Based on my search, I can provide you with the information about MLA and MP seats in Telangana:

## MLA Seats in Telangana

**Telangana has 119 seats in its Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha)**. This has been the number since the state's formation in 2014. The Telangana Legislative Assembly is the lower house of the Telangana Legislature, consisting of 119 elected members and 1 nominated member from the Anglo-Indian community.

## MP Seats in Telangana

**Telangana has 17 Lok Sabha (Parliamentary) seats**. This is the number of Members of Parliament (MPs) that Telangana sends to the Lok Sabha, the lower house of India's Parliament.

## Important Note About Future Changes

According to the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014, the number of seats in the Telangana Legislative Assembly is scheduled to be **increased from 119 to 153** after delimitation. However, this delimitation can only occur after 2026, as per Article 170(3) of the Constitution. The current constituencies will continue until the first census after 2026 is published, meaning new constituencies are unlikely before 2031.
